title: Sign up · GoLink Restaurant
heading: Register your business
description: Free, with no commitment. Your application is reviewed as soon as your documents are uploaded; if it is complete and compliant, it is approved automatically.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with at least one letter and one digit.
fields.referralHint: Filled in automatically if you came from a GoLink merchant’s link.

terms: I have read and accept GoLink’s partner terms, and I certify that the information entered is accurate.

errors.password: At least 10 characters, with a letter and a digit.
errors.terms: You must accept the partner terms.
errors.failed: Sign-up could not be completed. Check the fields and try again.

done.title: Your application is registered
done.text: We sent a confirmation e-mail to {{email}}. Sign in to upload your documents (business registration extract, ID, bank details) and accept the partner contract: your business is then approved.

waitlist.title: We are not in your city yet
waitlist.text: GoLink opens city by city. Your request is saved: we will contact you at {{email}} as soon as {{city}} opens.
